episodes.synopsis: Kanata, a member of the Takanozaki cheerleading team, is unable to perform after an accident during a competition. One morning, she encounters a girl named Suzuha, who is leaping across rooftops and walls.
episodes.title: Front Tuck Somersault Full Twist Layout

episodes.synopsis: Kanata, who decided to collaborate with Anna's video, discusses the project details with Onoka, Shion, and Emina, who had also joined. While brainstorming, Anna learns that there are various types of cheerleading...
episodes.title: Anyway, Something Like That...

episodes.synopsis: The quiet and unsociable Suzuha secretly admired Shion, whom she met at the entrance ceremony. While following her admired Shion around, Suzuha overheard Shion's singing...
episodes.title: I Always Look This Way

episodes.synopsis: Anna is thrilled by the increasing views on her cheerleading video and comes up with a special video project. To arrange music for the project, she visits Stout Records, the record store where she works part-time.
episodes.title: Capoeira Rhapsody

episodes.synopsis: Kanata and the others decide to film a support video for Anna and Stout Records. They dedicate themselves to cheerleading practice in preparation for the carnival, scheduled on the store's closing day.
episodes.title: An Exuberant Carnival Dance

episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation. The PoMPoMs gather at Emina's house for a video project meeting. Before the meeting, while everyone is relaxing, Suzuha suddenly starts checking the results of her lottery tickets...
episodes.title: No Cheer at the Hot Springs

episodes.synopsis: The PoMPoMs, who started their Cheer Delivery service, receive a request from Banka Rara, the captain of the Omaebashi High School Cheer Committee. The request is to help support the baseball team, which has made it to the quarterfinals of the prefectural tournament.
episodes.title: Stylish × Styleless!

episodes.synopsis: After the baseball support was broadcast on the news, the PoMPoMs received a flood of requests for support. The PoMPoMs sincerely tackle each request one by one, steadily making progress. However, overwhelmed by the sheer number of requests, everyone begins to feel exhausted.
episodes.title: What a Busy Summer

episodes.synopsis: The PoMPoMs are going through a crisis. Megumi confides in Shion and Nodoka and then has the opportunity to have a conversation with Kanata.
episodes.title: Rain and Cheer

episodes.synopsis: The PoMPoMs spend the rest of the summer fulfilling support requests. Kanata is feeling better and is slowly trying to get back into cheerleading.
episodes.title: Go Fight Win

episodes.synopsis: Kanata discovers that the negative comments were made by her senior in the cheerleading club, Mari. Unable to believe it, she becomes depressed.
episodes.title: Na-nare

episodes.synopsis: Mari has disappeared, and Kanata and the others go to look for her. After discovering her problem, they decide to cheer her on.
episodes.title: Hana-ni-nare
